tidystata: Tidy Tools Inspired by 'Stata'

Source: R/tidystata-package.R
tidystata-package.Rd

Stata-inspired tools for frequency tables, summary statistics, variable inspection, column selection, row calculations, and binning. Use tab(), summ(), and codebook() to start exploring a dataset.

Coming from Stata? findit() gives the R equivalent of a Stata command, such as findit(reg) or findit("merge 1:1 id").

Tutorials

Read vignette("getting-started", package = "tidystata") for a short workflow and vignette("containers-and-missing-values", package = "tidystata") for output containers, grouping and missing-value conventions.
